IGUI_HARMONIE_AssessmentLocked: Requires First Aid level %1 to interpret
IGUI_HARMONIE_KeybindAssess_tt: Opens the Nutrition Assessment window for yourself, or the nearest other player if one is close by.
IGUI_HARMONIE_KeybindAdmin_tt: Admin/debug only: opens the live vitamin + sandbox tuning panel. Bound to / by default.
IGUI_HARMONIE_AdminHint: Type a value and press Enter (or click elsewhere) to apply it. Hover any field for details.
IGUI_HARMONIE_AdminReserveTooltip: This vitamin's current Reserve, 0-100. Below the Critical threshold the deficiency penalty can fire (unless Pause Days are banked); at or above the Sufficient threshold it counts as fully recovered. Accepts decimals (e.g. 19.99) for testing right at a threshold.
IGUI_HARMONIE_AdminPauseDaysTooltip: Banked days that pause BOTH this vitamin's daily Reserve decay AND its critical-deficiency penalty, whichever it's needed for. 1 day is consumed per in-game day. Gained from eating well (reservePerPauseDay Reserve = 1 day), or +1 to every vitamin at once from taking a Vitamin Pill (Base.PillsVitamins).
IGUI_HARMONIE_PillsTaken: That should hold off the worst of the vitamin deficiency symptoms for a day.
